summary: This 424B5 form filed by Principal Financial Group Inc. is a prospectus supplement for a $400 million offering of 5.300% Senior Notes due 2037, guaranteed by Principal Financial Services Inc. The filing is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The notes are unsecured, pay interest semi-annually, and are not listed on any exchange. Proceeds to the issuer are approximately $396.2 million after underwriting discount. The transaction is a standard capital markets debt financing, not an extraordinary corporate event.
